caption: LUM-1282 multi-line composer: a draft past one row wraps, the prompt grows, the label stays on the first row, and the cursor `▍` is on the row the user is typing into. Pre-fix (LUM-1262 F1) the buffer was hard-clipped at the right margin and the user could not see what they had typed.

panels.label: 1. idle at 60x24: a single-line prompt placeholder, cursor on the only row
2. short draft: one composer row, cursor at end of buffer
3. long draft wraps to multiple composer rows; first row owns the label, continuation rows are indented

probe.why: LUM-1282 F1 fix: label row is first, body starts on the same row
continuation rows are indented (2 spaces), not labelled

panels.label: 4. cursor `▍` is on the row the user is typing into (last row when buffer is longer than the cap)
5. a paste of 80 columns wraps to two rows at 60 cols wide; the message view shrinks rather than the composer disappearing

probe.why: wrap continuation: chars 58+ land on row 2 with the indent
the body after the indent starts with 8, not 6, so `  6789` is not on the grid anywhere
